name: 会話に共有する引用段落
prompt:
Create a precise 390×108 px Japanese Slack quote-paragraph crop, matching the supplied native preview. Use a white #FFFFFF canvas. Draw one quiet vertical divider at x=24, y=8, width=2, height=86, in #E8ECE9. Place the quote text at x=40, y=16, width=326, height=48, in Meiryo Regular 14px, line height 24px, letter spacing 0, color #1D1D1D. Preserve this exact two-line copy and line break:
それぞれの話し合いでメモを残してください。
この進め方をみんなで考えていきましょう。

This text is quoted body copy, not a hyperlink; the native text style has no link target. Keep both lines dark and readable. Do not turn them blue. Add no quote marks, heading, avatar, icons, card, shadow, or extra labels. Match the native indentation, line positions, line spacing, and full 390×108 crop exactly.
